comment: Scripted E4 lamplight in the pavilion window (scripts/art/lamp.mjs), built from the current master's own pixels. Nothing outside the E4 region in edits.json can change; the wall tint fades to exactly 0 at its edge. Pixels on the 1536x1024 master, measured on v03.
tuning: Round 1 (amber [226,156,84] / [232,160,86], 30% of the old view kept as texture, flat panes) read as dull tan glass at 4x. Round 2: richer amber, less of the old view, and a soft falloff from a lamp low inside the room (lamp.at, lamp.falloff).
